body_markdown:
Finding out your favorite new artist is playing a concert just a few miles away. Mastering the lyrics to a song you’ve had on repeat. Digging into the credits and realizing the same songwriter is behind three of your favorite tracks. These are the moments that turn casual listening into true fandom.


Being a fan is about going deeper. That’s why Spotify continues to invest in features that help you connect with the music and artists you love. Here’s a roundup of a few of our favorites that will help you level up your listening.


## **Go behind the music with SongDNA**


Have you ever wondered who wrote that killer hook, or what classic track was sampled in a new hit? Our immersive music experience


[SongDNA](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-03-24/songdna-announcement-beta/) , built right into the Now Playing view, answers those questions and more. With just a tap, Premium subscribers can explore the writers, producers, and collaborators behind a song, see the samples that shaped its sound, and browse the covers it inspired. It’s a whole new way to understand the music you love, and with more than 100 million subscribers already diving in, it’s clear that fans are hungry for a closer look.

## **Never miss a show with Concerts Near You**


[Concerts Near You](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-03-20/our-new-concerts-near-you-playlist-makes-it-fun-and-easy-to-discover-touring-artists/) is a


[personalized playlist](https://spotify.link/concertsnearyou) that lets you discover upcoming concerts in your area. Updated every Wednesday, the playlist is inspired by your listening habits and features 30 songs from artists performing near you. With expandable track rows, you can get full event details and a direct link to purchase tickets.


To make sure you don’t miss your favorite artists, keep your notifications turned on for live concerts and events, keep your app updated, and set your location in your Live Events Feed.


## **Sing along with lyrics**


Lyrics are one of our most popular features, viewed hundreds of millions of times each day as fans follow along in real time. We recently


[made the experience even better](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-02-04/lyric-translations-offline-previews/) : Now you can translate lyrics in your language, follow along from anywhere with offline lyrics, and see them front and center with new lyrics previews.


## **Press play on music videos**


Last year, we expanded


[music videos in beta](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-12-09/music-videos-beta-premium-us-canada/) to Premium users in the U.S. and Canada, giving more fans access to official videos, live performances, and covers, right in the app. Now, you can switch seamlessly between audio and video on TV, desktop, iOS, and Android devices, bringing you one step closer to the music you love.


**Availability varies by market and plan*


## **Get front-of-the-line access with Reserved**


[Reserved](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-06-18/reserved-by-spotify-guide/) represents a new way for fans to connect with their favorite artists. This experience for eligible Premium subscribers (ages 18+) in the U.S. and Canada identifies an artist’s biggest fans and holds two tour tickets just for them. Using signals like your streams, saves, and shares, we offer you a window to purchase tickets before the general sale. It’s our way of saying thank you, and helping true fans get first dibs.


[https://storage.googleapis.com/pr-newsroom-wp/1/2026/08/Reserved-CA-GIF-1-smaller.mp4](https://storage.googleapis.com/pr-newsroom-wp/1/2026/08/Reserved-CA-GIF-1-smaller.mp4)


From lyrics to live shows to song credits, we’re helping you write the next chapter of your fandom. Because for true fans, there’s always more to discover.
